limitations: Finite independent four-cycle and symmetric two-state switch; positive rates; centered phosphorylation-count observable; stationary two-sided power spectrum. No generality for nonuniform cycles, coupled switches, different observables, or an actual singular thermodynamic transition is asserted.
scientific_integrity: Exact analysis of the global maximum of an established eight-state Markov power spectrum. The published spectrum and sufficient curvature condition are prior results. The additional conclusions are a sharp necessary-and-sufficient switching-rate criterion, a universal directionality partition, and continuous, degenerate, or jumping spectral-peak onset.
title: Sharp spectral-onset bifurcation in a stochastic phosphorylation ring with an independent switch
